query: How am I likely to respond to the proposed 15:30 escalation hour if it includes an evidence check and a next-morning follow-up slot?
target: I would agree conditionally, provided the evidence check and deferral path remain in place.
calibrated: accept only with explicit uncertainty safeguards
relation: The vendor-complaint sprint shows this user can label uncertainty before proposing ownership, while the earlier complaint review shows why this user should not accept a format that drops those safeguards.
A: During a vendor-complaint discovery sprint, I labeled each interview quote as observed, inferred, or open in the research notebook before proposing a follow-up owner at the insight-studio review; the program team scoped the next test instead of rewriting the script.
B: In an April vendor-complaint review, I committed to a product explanation before separating interview quotes from team inference, and the group built the wrong follow-up script.
E1: The proposed 15:30 office hour is on the interview calendar, and the five-minute evidence-check slot begins at 15:25.
E2: The research calendar leaves a 10:30 slot for next-day evidence review, and the deferral form permits moving unverified cases to that window.
B_prime: In a June 15:30 escalation hour, I read the intake timestamps, recorded which quotes were still unverified, and tracked requested follow-ups; the program manager proposed the owner after the evidence check, and the conclusion remained pending.
lure: A senior designer said saying yes immediately would show that I can handle pressure.

Cleaner than drip-feeding answers.
Much cleaner.
